response.rationale: Yes, A and B name the same capability. Both are anchored on the same class, IceMonitorService (node f59a45a01c2ed338, layer domain, component business). Their names are nearly identical: B only adds the word "management" to "Ice condition monitoring and session hold". The difference is in scope. A is a community that also takes in IceMonitorService's collaborators, such as SessionRepository (infrastructure/persistence) and the DropTextClient and PuckPayClient clients. B is the same domain class seen within the business component. These are two views of one capability, not two different ones.
